messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Symmetry-restricted ansatz decomposing the square into congruent subregions with one point each

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal symmetry-restricted configuration partitions the unit square into 13 congruent right triangles via a (3×4)+1 subdivision, placing one point at the incenter of each sub-triangle plus a single point at the square's center, achieving a minimum triangle area of exactly 1/144. No arrangement of 13 points with one point in each of 13 congruent subregions of the unit square can yield a larger minimum area among all 286 triples."}
